records.narrative: Exhaustive analytical verification over the unit's entire (binary) domain: pre-activation is negative at both attainable input values, so the unit outputs exactly zero everywhere and its readout contributes nothing. Unearned structure that survived selection in a noiseless task because nothing priced it - the clean null instance of the unearned-structure diagnosis pattern.

payload.note: Pre-activation = sum(alpha_j * I_j) + C over the six rule indicators; unit inputs depend on no other variables, so the 64 indicator patterns are the entire domain. Largest two-indicator sum (a3+a5) reaches -1.82 (ReLU off); smallest three-indicator sum (a1+a4+a6) reaches +1.26 (on). Fires iff count >= 3, with margin >= 1.26 on and >= 1.82 off.

records.narrative: Exhaustive analytical verification: the gate is exactly an at-least-three-of-six detector over the MONK-2 rule indicators. Binary attributes a3, a6 enter via complements (negative weight on the complement = positive weight on the indicator). Coefficients derived from connection weights times the z-scaling deltas of the one-hot inputs; verified over all 64 attainable indicator patterns.

payload.note: Sum of direct-connection contributions evaluated per attribute value over z-scaled one-hots. Rises with the number of active rule indicators; with the output bias, the minimum over all count-2 configurations is positive (+0.42) and the maximum over all count-0/1 configurations is negative (-0.65), before the gate is considered. Values computed from full-dataset scaler statistics; exact per-configuration values verified in the extensional check on the root annotation.

records.narrative: Analytical verification: the direct connections form a count ramp. Every attribute contributes positively at its first value and negatively otherwise; the ramp plus output bias crosses zero between one and two active indicators, supplying the lower edge of the response peak. Within-attribute variation (e.g. a4=3 near zero) never reorders the count bands.

payload.note: Evaluated on the complete input space (all 432 attribute configurations; train and test partitions both perfect). Predictions match the MONK-2 generating rule (exactly two of six attributes at first value) on every input: the composed network is extensionally equal to the rule. Computed on the post-refactoring model state (1 identity insertion, 6 node splits), confirming function preservation. Mechanism: ramp forms the lower edge of the peak at count 2 (min positive-class pre-activation +0.42), the -7.34-weighted at-least-three gate forms the upper edge (max count-3 output pre-activation -2.03), and the inert unit contributes zero.

records.narrative: Extensional equality with the generating rule, verified over the entire input space. The composition realises a response peak at exactly two active indicators using one linear ramp and a single gate under the output threshold.
